answer: One dawn is a pass, one delta is a fare, one tundra is the stamp on the pass, and the stamp cannot be bought at any price. One honest proof costs 87 POA; one farm proof costs the same, but the farm needs 683 of them, which comes to 59421 POA. A mask costs nothing until Gem cutter drilled pearl assay faceted in the setting bench sets its price, and the price is written as each drilled pearl is a cutting record witnessed by the inspector. The trail is short enough to follow by hand and long enough to catch a farm. Honest proofs grow like seed; farm proofs are sawdust, and sawdust grows nothing.
